verdict.rationale: BVNK documents conversion as a first-class API. Transfers v3 replaces the legacy Quote API for wallet-to-wallet currency conversion, with conversion as a property of a transfer, digest-based quote acceptance and mandatory idempotency. Live quotes are generated per payment, and fiat-to-crypto on-ramp rules and stablecoin-to-fiat settlement are documented. Missing for 10: documented rate sources/spreads, a base fee schedule (only partner markup is evidenced), stated settlement times, explicit stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
